title: Crestline Fleet Account Weekend Allowance on Disputed Over-Limit Tickets
content:
On a Crestline Fleet Account, for a ticket a business disputes as an unapproved over-limit ticket, a weekend allowance is added to the authorized amount, because the fleet desk that takes approval calls is closed on weekends.

| Day of the week of the ticket's date | Weekend allowance |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 75.00 |
| Saturday | 50.00 |
| Monday through Friday | nothing |

The ticket's date is the invoice date of the disputed invoice; the day of the week is the calendar day of the week of that date.

## Questions on the allowance

- *A ticket dated on a Friday?* No weekend allowance.
- *A ticket dated on a Saturday?* 50.00.
- *A ticket dated on a Sunday?* 75.00.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On an account whose authorized amount would otherwise be 1320.00, a disputed ticket dated on a Sunday raises it by 75.00, to 1395.00. The same ticket dated on the following Monday would carry no weekend allowance.
